title: The UK CMA proposes rules requiring Google and Android OEMs to offer search choice screens on first use and via yearly prompts, new AI assistant rules, and more (Steve Dent/Engadget)
summary: Steve Dent / Engadget: The UK CMA proposes rules requiring Google and Android OEMs to offer search choice screens on first use and via yearly prompts, new AI assistant rules, and more — It would also require smartphone makers to give users a choice of AI assistants. — The UK's Competition and Markets Authority …

Steve Dent / Engadget :

The UK CMA proposes rules requiring Google and Android OEMs to offer search choice screens on first use and via yearly prompts, new AI assistant rules, and more   —  It would also require smartphone makers to give users a choice of AI assistants.  —  The UK's Competition and Markets Authority …
